headline: Strathcona Pitches 250,000-Bpd Oil Export Route to Asia via Canada
summary: Canadian oil producer Strathcona Resources wants to export up to 250,000 barrels per day of crude from British Columbia to Asia using rail and a new marine terminal, requiring an exemption from Ottawa's oil tanker ban.
why: Strathcona Resources is an independent Canadian energy producer. Expanding export routes to Asian markets would alter North American heavy crude supply dynamics and shipping logistics.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Approval of the terminal and tanker ban exemption could open new export channels for Canadian crude.
